intendedObjective: Check usability and correct only wording that could cause employees to misunderstand the process.
acceptableEditScope: Targeted clarification of genuine process misunderstandings; retain effective instructions.
stableFactsAndClaims: Corrections require the shift date, recorded and proposed times, and reason; each submission allows three shifts.
A request does not immediately change the timecard; the supervisor checks the shift record and contacts the employee if entries differ.
Status appears beside the original timecard; original and proposed entries remain visible until review ends.
Missing shifts use Add a shift, not Correct a shift; these ask for different information.
Rejected worked dates must be sent with the error message to scheduling; employees must not substitute an inaccurate date.

sourceObjectiveEvidence.quote: Check this internal guide for ease of use. Make changes only where an employee could otherwise misunderstand the process.
Use the correction form when a submitted timecard contains an error.
